body: Issue sweep: this looks no longer applicable: commit `e7d7b1b2d` (PR #3650) generated `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.camproj` and `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.nc` again with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`. That commit replaced the `08697d3c4` files and their 7-line difference. In addition, `crates/app/tests/continuous_4axis_part.rs` already has `the_committed_project_posts_the_committed_program`. This test loads the committed project, posts it, and compares the result with `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.nc`. Commit `fb990ef91` intentionally replaced byte-for-byte `assert_eq!` with `wrapped_nc::compare` (`crates/app/tests/common/wrapped_nc.rs`). The `#1904` decision in `RECOMMENDED.md` allows one 0.001-degree step on `A` words across platforms. That decision also rejects replacing the golden with the output of one platform. The maintainer decides whether to close it.
